assurance: hash-checked snapshots and recomputed model identities; NOT native optimizer replay, custody closure, gradient causality, or held-out learning
controls: same matrix names, seed, lane, admitted data/source closure, ascending steps and unchanged quantizer; no intervention
required_metrics: per-matrix detached absmean scale and code identities
per-matrix strict STE abs(W/scale)<1 support fraction
normalized zero-code and saturation boundary proximity
observed latent changes and code transitions between frozen steps
optional optimizer moment support labelled as historic state, not current incoming gradient
scope: read-only descriptive analysis of native ternary checkpoint tensors; no update/replay/causal or learning gate claim
selection: caller freezes exact cells, checkpoint steps and expected payload/metadata identities before analysis; no outcome-selected checkpoints
